video_title: BLOCK PARTY LIVE PT. 1 🗽 Jose Alvarado, Mariska Join Jalen, Josh for Championship Celebration

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson confirms he is fully cleared for training camp
quotes.excerpt: I had surgery this off season and I just wanted to tell you guys that I am fully cleared.
quotes.quote: As you guys know, I had surgery this off season and I just wanted to tell you guys that I am fully cleared.

quotes.speaker: Jose Alvarado
quotes.summary_phrase: Jose Alvarado reflects on the pivotal Game 4 loss against the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: If we never won that Game 4 because that missed layup, he cannot be around here.
quotes.quote: If we never won that Game 4 because that missed layup, he cannot be around here. You know what I'm saying?

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the team's need for a player like Jose Alvarado
quotes.excerpt: This is the kind of guy we need because he can handle the ball, he can take pressure off Jalen.
quotes.quote: I was lobbying for him. I was like, yo, we need this type of player. This is the kind of guy we need because he can handle the ball, he can take pressure off Jalen. He can shoot decently. He's come to bring energy. He's going to make his teammates better.

quotes.speaker: Mariska Hargitay
quotes.summary_phrase: Mariska Hargitay on how the Knicks' playoff run changed her life
quotes.excerpt: All of us that experienced it, it actually changed our lives and it changes the ceiling of what is possible.
quotes.quote: All of us that experienced it, it actually changed our lives and it changes the ceiling of what is possible. And it breaks it all open and it just reorganizes our existence.

quotes.speaker: Landry Shamet
quotes.summary_phrase: Landry Shamet on the challenges of training camp and team adversity
quotes.excerpt: Two years in a row training camp deal, got thrown some adversity, but obviously it all panned out.
quotes.quote: Two years in a row training camp deal, got thrown some adversity, but obviously it all panned out. And having good teammates like you guys and people who believe in you beyond just relying on yourself. Having a great group, a great group of fans obviously, people to go out and play for. Having to go through all the trials, tribulations, struggles, made the culmination that much sweeter. Winning a championship and being with this group was made all that very worth it.

quotes.speaker: Jose Alvarado
quotes.summary_phrase: Jose Alvarado on the importance of team unity and shared goals
quotes.excerpt: there's a point where ulterior motives and kind of like unity breaks
quotes.quote: I think it was the part that I mentioned earlier. Every team I've been on, there's a point where ulterior motives and kind of like unity breaks. I genuinely never felt that this year. There wasn't one point where we were like, you know, we have our little run-ins and people butt heads, that's what teams are, but never truly underlying like, I'm kind of hoping things don't go well for him so I can, whatever. That never happened one time and that was special.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson and Josh Hart discuss their teammate dynamic
quotes.excerpt: What's the most annoying thing about being teammates with Josh Hart?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: What's the most annoying thing about being teammates with Josh Hart?

text_blocks.speaker: Jose Alvarado
text_blocks.text: The most annoying thing about being teammates with Josh Hart? I feel like certain guys, if I've done well and I might be shooting myself in the foot here, but I feel like they don't really annoy me a whole lot. And that might just completely open a whole new can of worms. This year is going to be terrible for me.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: Jalen says a couple of things. Hey, stop. We know. You asked me and I stopped.

text_blocks.speaker: Jose Alvarado
text_blocks.text: You asked me and I stopped. You said I could only use it like once or twice and I use it.

quotes.speaker: Jose Alvarado
quotes.summary_phrase: Jose Alvarado on the sacrifice and team culture in New York
quotes.excerpt: this team I think is special because we're all willing to sacrifice
quotes.quote: You saved my ass a lot this year, bro. And like you said, this team I think is special because we're all willing to sacrifice. I truly think you're right in the middle of that, bro, because you've had amazing moments for us. You've won big games for us, but you also been willing to sacrifice. And I think I can sit here and say on behalf of all of New York, we're so happy that you resigned this year, man, and we appreciate you, dog.
